report.summary: Checkout requests are intermittently timing out and failing because the network proxy (toxiproxy) between order-service and payment-service is introducing delays exceeding 3 seconds. While payment-service itself processes payments quickly (under 280ms), order-service's HTTP client cancels payment calls after its 3-second timeout, causing orders to enter an unknown payment state and return 503 errors to customers.
report.root_cause: Network latency / jitter introduced by toxiproxy between order-service and payment-service exceeds the order-service HTTP client timeout of 3.0 seconds, causing java.util.concurrent.CancellationException and leaving orders in PAYMENT_UNKNOWN status.

evidence.finding: 55 orders ended in PAYMENT_UNKNOWN status in the last 5 minutes (at 2026-10-18T19:28:00Z) while 46,511 were CONFIRMED.
order-service logged 55 ERRORs (395 in 10 minutes) between 19:19:06Z and 19:29:05Z stating 'Payment outcome unknown, needs reconciliation' with error_type java.util.concurrent.CancellationException.
http_client_requests_seconds_max for application='order-service', client_name='toxiproxy' reached 3.01s - 3.16s, matching the CancellationException client error max duration of 3.01s - 3.03s.

payment-service internal http_server_requests_seconds_max on POST /payments was only 0.211s - 0.279s, with p95 latency between 3.48ms and 5.17ms and zero 5xx errors, proving the latency is introduced in transit via toxiproxy rather than payment-service itself.
order_service_dependency_avg_latency_ms for toxiproxy spiked up to 16.92ms at 19:28:50Z, while payment-service p95 latency remained low at 3.48ms.

timeline: 19:19:06 UTC - First wave of CancellationException errors and 503 responses observed in order-service client calls to toxiproxy
19:22:51 UTC - Traffic and error rates momentarily dipped to zero
19:28:00 UTC - High order volume resumed; 55 orders placed into PAYMENT_UNKNOWN status within 1 minute
19:28:22 UTC - Recurring java.util.concurrent.CancellationException errors logged in order-service on payment calls
19:28:50 UTC - toxiproxy dependency latency from order-service peaked at 16.92ms with 0.93 5xx errors/sec on /orders
report.customer_impact: At least 55 orders in the last 5 minutes (and 395 in the last 10 minutes) failed with 503 Service Unavailable, leaving affected customers with an unknown payment outcome requiring reconciliation.
ruled_out: payment-service internal failure or degradation: ruled out because payment-service recorded zero 5xx errors, 100% 201 status returns, and max server-side execution time of 279ms.
Database connection pool exhaustion: ruled out because db_pool_pending remained at 0 across all services and active connections never exceeded 5 of 10 max pool size.
Inventory exhaustion: ruled out because inventory-service returned 0 errors with ample stock (>9.8M units per SKU) and low latency (~10ms p95).
Recent application deployments: ruled out because no deployments occurred in the last 180 minutes.
recommended_actions: Inspect and remove any active toxic/latency configurations on the toxiproxy instance for payment-service.
Run automated reconciliation on the 55 (and preceding 340) PAYMENT_UNKNOWN orders against payment-service records to confirm whether customers were charged.
Review order-service client timeout and retry policies for downstream payment requests to avoid abrupt cancellations near 3.0 seconds.
